name: Snipe-IT v8
description: Snipe-IT is a free, open source IT asset management system.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: snipe/snipe-it:v8.8.3@sha256:eb6d78c1bdae46d15177b149fcc14d7cd795d9f6c17e53dc4d87e04da9653218
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:80"
    environment:
      APP_ENV: production
      APP_DEBUG: "false"
      APP_KEY: $APP_KEY
      APP_URL: $APP_URL
      APP_TIMEZONE: UTC
      APP_LOCALE: en-US
      DB_CONNECTION: mariadb
      DB_HOST: db
      DB_PORT: 3306
      DB_DATABASE: snipeit
      DB_USERNAME: snipeit
      DB_PASSWORD: $DB_PASSWORD
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/storage:/var/lib/snipeit
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
        restart: true
  db:
    image: mariadb:11.4.7@sha256:39596f079862334be04f4231664862e55d4febe54309cc62f750f2297de85b06
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: snipeit
      MYSQL_USER: snipeit
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: $DB_PASSWORD
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: $MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/db_data:/var/lib/mysql
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "healthcheck.sh", "--connect", "--innodb_initialized"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 1s
      retries: 5
notes: This is a separate Snipe-IT v8 app. Migration from the legacy Snipe-IT app is manual; configure APP_KEY, APP_URL, DB_PASSWORD, and MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD before installing.
